Yes, those saving edge cases all match my intent now. If I paste nonsense, it gently stops me and shows what a real address looks like instead of making a junk entry. If the app can't reach a page to fetch its details, it still keeps my link safe with a clear note and lets me retry or fill things in myself. And it won't pile up duplicates over throwaway differences like tracking tags or a jump-to-section, while still keeping genuinely different pages as their own bookmarks.

That's the careful, doesn't-lose-my-stuff, doesn't-clutter behavior I'd want around saving. Settled for me.

I think that covers everything I came in wanting — effortless saving, labels, finding, read-later, archiving, deleting, and the tricky corner cases. I'm ready to see it all come together as the finished app whenever you are.
